name: Trolltunga
coordinateNote: Continue on foot. Check parking and shuttle access with the operator.
description: An extraordinary ledge above Lake Ringedalsvatnet.

name: Vøringsfossen
coordinateNote: Road access to Fossli; continue on foot to the viewing platforms.
description: Water, stone and a remarkable valley.

name: Geirangerfjord
description: A journey through the monumental fjord landscape.

name: Preikestolen
coordinateNote: Continue on foot. There is no road to the summit.
description: A granite plateau above the Lysefjord.

name: Lofoten
coordinateNote: Lofoten spans several municipalities. This badge represents Moskenes, the municipality of the selected gateway Reine.
description: Sharp peaks, sheltered harbours and open sea.

name: Nærøyfjord
coordinateNote: Road access to Gudvangen; continue along the fjord by boat.
description: Narrow waters beneath steep mountains.

name: Steinsdalsfossen
coordinateNote: The pin identifies the waterfall. Use designated roadside parking and continue on foot.
description: A waterfall with a path behind its curtain of water.

name: Atlantic Road
coordinateNote: The road crosses Averøy and Hustadvika. This badge represents Averøy, the municipality of the selected stop.
description: Island bridges at the edge of the Norwegian Sea.

name: Senja
coordinateNote: Senja island is much larger than this selected gateway.
description: Sculpted mountains meet the open Atlantic.

name: Reine
description: A fishing village beneath dramatic coastal peaks.

name: Reinebringen
coordinateNote: Use designated parking in Reine, then walk to the steps.
description: A mountain perspective across islands and fjords.

name: Åndalsnes & Rampestreken
coordinateNote: Continue on foot to the viewpoint.
description: A fjord town surrounded by mountains, with a celebrated viewpoint above the valley.

name: Kjosfossen
coordinateNote: There is no normal road access to Kjosfossen. Continue by Flåmsbana train, which stops at the waterfall.
description: Powerful water in a steep mountain valley.

name: Låtefossen
coordinateNote: The pin identifies the waterfall. Stop only in designated areas along the busy road.
description: Twin cascades in a landscape shaped by water.

name: Nigardsbreen
coordinateNote: Continue by the local access road, on foot or by seasonal boat. Glacier walks require a guide.
description: Blue ice and a remarkable glacial landscape.

name: Bergen & Bryggen
photoCaption: Bergen & Bryggen · 2 · Diego Delso · CC BY-SA 4.0
description: Colourful waterfront lanes beneath the seven mountains.

name: Ålesund
description: Art Nouveau streets and islands seen from Aksla.

name: Stegastein
coordinateNote: Mountain-road access. Check seasonal conditions and parking restrictions.
description: A viewing platform suspended above the Aurlandsfjord.

name: Trollstigen
coordinateNote: Road access depends on season, weather and closures. Check current road status before departure.
description: Hairpin bends and waterfalls in a dramatic mountain pass.

name: Besseggen
coordinateNote: Continue on foot, or take the seasonal boat to Memurubu first. Check bookings and season.
description: A celebrated ridge between the blue waters of Gjende and Bessvatnet.

name: Bondhusvatnet
